metadata.description: Personal Claude Code extensions — dev workflow helpers and more.

plugins.name: coderabbit-tools
plugins.description: AI code review backed by the CodeRabbit CLI — /coderabbit-review (read-only report) and /coderabbit-fix (review → apply suggested fixes), plus a background review agent. User-invoked only.

plugins.name: codex-tools
plugins.description: Plan / review / debug ops backed by OpenAI's Codex CLI. Read-only delegation, user-invoked only.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Universal dev workflow — branch naming conventions, ticket-driven branch creation (in place or in a separate worktree), ticket capture for bugs/improvements, pre-PR documentation sync, and a pre-PR quality review that fixes valid findings, cleans up comments, and opens/updates the PR.

plugins.name: gemini-tools
plugins.description: Plan / review / debug ops backed by Google's Gemini CLI. Read-only delegation, user-invoked only.

plugins.name: git-platform
plugins.description: Unified MCP server for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket — PR create / list / view / update / merge / approve / comment (incl. inline) / decline, plus PR commits & files, branch list/view, commit view, and CI checks. Auto-detected from the repo's git remote.
